purpose: Governed self-scoped automatic absolute Schedule move request capability that enforces current Movement Policy, hard Temporal Constraints, CAS and idempotency before either direct commit or proposal creation.

routine.return_type: TABLE(schedule_ref uuid, subject_native_ref uuid, movement_policy_material_state_ref uuid, result_kind text, proposal_ref uuid, placement_material_state_ref uuid, created_at timestamp with time zone, replayed boolean)

state_history.material_state_behavior: Direct path appends a Schedule placement MaterialState; confirmation path creates only proposal/control rows.
state_history.current_binding: Requires exact current placement and current Movement Policy bases; direct path advances Schedule currentness, pending path does not.
state_history.chronology: Direct commit uses monotonic placement history transition; pending proposal has separate creation time.
state_history.immutability_policy: Existing placement/policy MaterialStates are never rewritten; replay returns original committed/pending effect.

lifecycle.retention: Retain request receipt and any proposal/resulting placement history for replay and auditability.

obligations: confirmation_required returns pending without mutating Schedule
direct automatic move commits only hard-admissible absolute placement
soft preference does not block commit
stale placement and operation-id changed intent reject
same constraint with different Movement Policy yields different authority behavior
